name: 1/10 scale 59 x 26 mm road tire on hex-12 rim
manufacturer: Custom concept (dimensioned from published 1/10 tire ranges)
uncertainty: Matrix 1/10 Formula tires publish 59 mm diameter and 30 mm width; eXcelerate 1/10 fronts publish 62 x 29 mm; Hot Race 1/10 fronts publish 59 mm. Modelled at 59 x 26 mm to fit a 59 mm rolling diameter with a 12 mm hex hub as listed by 1/10 wheel sets. Compound and profile are design choices, not measured.
mass_source: Estimated for a 59 x 26 foam/rubber tire plus nylon rim. Not a manufacturer figure.
